ActivityLogRow.role: Clickable list-group item showing a markdown-rendered activity-log message with a relative date underneath
ActivityLogRow.note: Needs i18n plus $lib/activity-log.util translation mapping and MarkdownRenderer/Date child components; realistic log object required

AddEditLanguageModal.role: Bootstrap centered modal form to create/edit a site language: name, ISO code, date-fns locale select, derivative-keyword badge chips, submit footer button
AddEditLanguageModal.note: Legacy Svelte 4 syntax; no props — state lives in module stores set by exported show(); renders from store defaults but hidden (.modal.fade) — needs i18n init, a window.bootstrap.Modal shim, and forcing .show/.d-block; API only on submit

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, mode, locale, error, derivative) — imperative API via exported show/hide/setCallback/onHide

AddEditPostCategoryModal.role: Centered modal form to create/edit a post category: title input, description textarea, /category/ URL input-group with auto-slug, submit footer
AddEditPostCategoryModal.note: No props; needs i18n, bootstrap Modal shim, forced-visible modal classes, and stores seeded via exported show(); network only on submit

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, mode, category, errors) — imperative show/hide/setCallback/onHide API

AddEditTicketCategoryModal.role: Centered modal form to create/edit a ticket category: title input, description textarea, submit footer button
AddEditTicketCategoryModal.note: No props; needs i18n, bootstrap Modal shim, forced-visible classes; state seeded via exported show(); network only on submit

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, mode, category, errors) — imperative show/hide/setCallback/onHide API

AddonLicenseCard.role: Bootstrap card showing premium addon license state: status icon, refresh button, guidance text, and buy/connect CTA buttons per licenseStatus
AddonLicenseCard.note: Renders from an `addon` object prop; needs i18n, $app/paths base shim, and a websiteDisplayHost stub; refresh action only fires on click

AddonStartupErrorModal.role: Large dark terminal-styled modal showing a plugin/theme startup error log in monospace with custom scrollbar, copy-to-clipboard and close buttons
AddonStartupErrorModal.note: Purely presentational content but fed via module store set by show(); needs i18n, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes, and sample log text passed to show()

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, errorContent) — imperative show(content)/hide API

App.role: Invisible root shell: injects dev stylesheet link, renders PageLoader and page content slot, initializes Bootstrap popovers on navigation
App.note: App shell, not presentational; depends on $app/stores page subscription, browser lib bootstrapping, and @theme-style alias — nothing worth showing in a DS

AuthorizePlayerModal.role: Centered modal to assign a permission group to a player: perm-group select populated from API, placeholder permission toggle list, save footer; spinner while loading
AuthorizePlayerModal.note: loading store defaults true so it renders only a spinner; show() immediately GETs /api/panel/permissionGroups — needs API mock or manual store surgery to show real content

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, player, loading, permissionGroups, errors, submitLoading) — imperative show/hide/setCallback/onHide API

BanHistoryRow.role: Table row: avatar+username link, ban duration text with tooltip, reason, email-notified badge, banned-by avatar, source badge, date
BanHistoryRow.note: Needs base-path/avatarVersion/currentLanguage shims and tooltip action; avatar imgs 404 without backend but layout holds

BanSourceBadge.role: Colored Bootstrap badge with icon + localized label indicating where a ban originated (panel/migration/server/other), with tooltip showing raw source.
BanSourceBadge.note: Pure presentational; needs svelte-i18n locale JSON and the tooltip action (tippy) available.

Bottom.role: Sidebar footer row of four icon links: docs, Pano website, Discord, report-a-bug.
Bottom.note: No props; calls getContext('session'/'panelTheme'/'siteInfo') but never uses the values, so contexts can be absent — needs i18n + $lib/variables. Dark sidebar background required for text-light links to be visible.

CardFilters.role: Horizontally scrollable btn-group wrapper that holds CardFiltersItem pills
CardFilters.note: Trivial wrapper div; just needs slotted children

CardFiltersItem.role: Small outline-primary pill button or link used as a filter toggle inside CardFilters, active-state highlighted
CardFiltersItem.note: Pure presentational; only needs a trivial base path shim; contains leftover console.log calls in click handlers

CardHeader.role: Responsive card-header row with title on the left, optional centered middle content, and right-aligned filters/actions
CardHeader.note: Pure layout; needs named slot content passed in (legacy slot API, so React bridge must supply slots)

CategoryBadge.role: Clickable Bootstrap badge linking to a category-filtered posts/tickets list; primary color for 'no category', secondary otherwise.
CategoryBadge.note: Renders from props alone; only needs a `base` shim from $app/paths (imports `_` but never uses it in markup).

ChangelogModal.role: Large centered modal rendering a release changelog as markdown via MarkdownRenderer, with header title and close button
ChangelogModal.note: Renders from changelogContent store set via show(markdown); needs i18n, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes, and MarkdownRenderer compiles along with it

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, changelogContent) — imperative show(content)/hide API

ConfirmActionModal.role: Minimal generic confirm dialog: question-mark icon, i18n message ($_ of a passed key), Cancel / Yes (danger) footer buttons
ConfirmActionModal.note: Simplest of the set, no API at all; title is an i18n KEY resolved via $_ so needs i18n init plus bootstrap shim and forced-visible classes

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, titleValue) — imperative show(titleKey, callback)/hide API

ConfirmBanIpModal.role: Centered modal to ban an IP: IP input with find-player button, ban-message textarea with char counter, permanent/custom/datetime radio button-group with conditional duration select or datetime input, Cancel/Yes footer
ConfirmBanIpModal.note: Renders fully from store defaults (permanent selected); needs i18n, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; pulls in SearchPlayerModal + ToastContainer at compile time; API only on submit

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, ipAddress, banMessage, banDuration, customDuration, customDateTime) — imperative show({initialIp})/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmBanPlayerModal.role: Centered modal to ban a player: ban-message textarea with 255 char counter, permanent/custom/datetime radio button-group with conditional inputs, email-notify checkbox, Cancel/Yes (danger) footer
ConfirmBanPlayerModal.note: Renders from store defaults without a player object; needs i18n, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; API only on submit

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, player, sendNotification, banMessage, banDuration, customDuration, customDateTime) — imperative show(player)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmCloseTicketModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog for closing one or many tickets: icon, single/multi i18n message, Cancel/Yes footer
ConfirmCloseTicketModal.note: Needs i18n, a $app/paths base shim, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; selectedTickets defaults [] so multi-title shows; API only on confirm

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, selectedTickets) — imperative show(ticketIds)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmDeleteLanguageModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog for deleting a language: question icon, i18n message, Cancel/Yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDeleteLanguageModal.note: Static i18n message, no data needed to look right; needs i18n init, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; API only on confirm

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, locale) — imperative show(locale)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmDeletePlayerModal.role: Confirm dialog for deleting a player account with a current-password input (danger border on error), Cancel/Yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDeletePlayerModal.note: Needs i18n plus shims for $app/navigation goto and $app/paths base, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; API/goto only on confirm

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, player, loading, passwordError, currentPassword, passwordInput) — imperative show(player)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmDeletePostCategoryModal.role: Confirm dialog for deleting a post category; if the category has posts, shows a warning alert listing affected posts as badge-pill links plus an overflow count
ConfirmDeletePostCategoryModal.note: Category store default has posts:[] but no postCount, so the warning branch renders (postCount !== 0 is true for undefined) — seed a realistic category via show(); needs i18n, base shim, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, category) — imperative show(category)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmDeletePostModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog for deleting/trashing a post: icon, permanent-vs-trash i18n message keyed on post.status, Cancel/Yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDeletePostModal.note: Renders fine from store default (empty post → trash-title branch); needs i18n, $app/paths base shim, bootstrap shim, forced-visible classes; API only on confirm

stores: module-level writables (modalElement, post) — imperative show(post)/hide/setCallback/onHide API

ConfirmDeleteTicketCategoryModal.role: Bootstrap centered confirm dialog: question icon, warning text listing up to 5 affected tickets as links, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDeleteTicketCategoryModal.note: No props; opened via module show(category) which needs window.bootstrap.Modal — for static render must force .show/.d-block and seed the module store; deletes via API only on confirm

ConfirmDeleteTicketModal.role: Bootstrap centered confirm dialog: question icon, single/multi delete-ticket message, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDeleteTicketModal.note: No props; module-level show(tickets) + window.bootstrap needed to open; markup itself is simple and renders from i18n alone once forced visible

ConfirmDisableAddonWillCauseMoreDisableM.role: Confirm dialog with question icon, alert-warning box listing dependent addons as warning badge links, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDisableAddonWillCauseMoreDisableM.note: No props; needs show(plugin) via window.bootstrap and seeded plugin store (id, dependents[]) plus base path shim; no API call itself (delegates to callback)

ConfirmDisableEmailModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog: question icon, single i18n title line, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmDisableEmailModal.note: Pure static markup from i18n; only blocker is Bootstrap-managed visibility (needs .show forced or window.bootstrap shim to call show())

ConfirmDraftPostModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog: question icon, draft-post title line, cancel/yes (secondary) footer
ConfirmDraftPostModal.note: Static from i18n alone; needs forced visibility (Bootstrap modal classes) since it mounts hidden until show(continueProcess)

ConfirmEnablingAddonWillCauseMoreEnableM.role: Confirm dialog with alert-warning box listing not-started dependency addons as warning badge links, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmEnablingAddonWillCauseMoreEnableM.note: No props; needs seeded plugin store (id, notStartedDependencies[]) via show(), base path shim, and forced modal visibility

ConfirmInstallResourceModal.role: Rich install/update/downgrade/reinstall confirm dialog: action icon and title, unverified/downgrade warning alerts, resource card with remote icon or screenshot, version badge, author/size meta, changelog and copy-hash buttons
ConfirmInstallResourceModal.note: Needs show(versionInfo, type) with a realistic versionInfo object plus forced visibility; icon/screenshot img hits PANO_WEBSITE_API_URL (broken offline but has icon fallback); imports ChangelogModal too

ConfirmPublishPostModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog: question icon, publish-post title line, cancel/yes (secondary) footer
ConfirmPublishPostModal.note: Static from i18n alone; needs forced Bootstrap-modal visibility since show(continueProcess) drives display via window.bootstrap

ConfirmRemoveAddonModal.role: Confirm dialog: question icon, remove-addon title interpolating pluginId, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmRemoveAddonModal.note: Needs pluginId store seeded via show(pluginId, continueProcess) and forced visibility; otherwise pure i18n markup

ConfirmRemoveAddonWillCauseMoreUnloadMod.role: Confirm dialog with alert-warning box listing addons that would also unload, shown as warning badge links, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmRemoveAddonWillCauseMoreUnloadMod.note: Needs seeded plugin store (id, removeDependents[]) via show(), base path shim, forced visibility; default store lacks removeDependents so unseeded render throws in the #each

ConfirmRemoveAllNotificationsModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog: question icon, remove-all-notifications title, cancel/yes (secondary) footer
ConfirmRemoveAllNotificationsModal.note: Static from i18n; ApiUtil.delete only fires on confirm click; needs forced Bootstrap-modal visibility

ConfirmRemovePanoAccountModal.role: Minimal confirm dialog: question icon, disconnect-Pano-account title, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmRemovePanoAccountModal.note: Static from i18n alone; needs forced Bootstrap-modal visibility (mounts hidden until show(continueProcess))

ConfirmRemovePermGroupModal.role: Confirm dialog whose icon and alert escalate for admin groups: warning triangle plus alert-warning/alert-danger last-admin-group notice, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmRemovePermGroupModal.note: Needs show(group, nodes) to seed stores (group name, permission nodes drive isAdminGroup/isOnlyAdminGroup states) and forced visibility; renders '-' fallbacks unseeded

ConfirmRemovePermTrackModal.role: Confirm dialog: question icon, remove-track title interpolating track name, cancel/yes (danger) footer
ConfirmRemovePermTrackModal.note: Needs show(track) to seed track name (falls back to '-') and forced Bootstrap-modal visibility; otherwise pure i18n markup

ConfirmRemovePermUserModal.role: Centered Bootstrap confirm dialog: question-circle icon, 'remove user from permission group?' text with username, cancel + red yes buttons.
ConfirmRemovePermUserModal.note: Legacy Svelte 4; state (user) set via module show() not props; hidden by 'modal fade' until forced visible; needs i18n + window.bootstrap stub.

ConfirmRemoveThemeModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: question icon, delete-theme message (variant if theme is active), cancel + red yes buttons.
ConfirmRemoveThemeModal.note: Text driven by module-level 'active' store set in show(); force .show/.d-block and init i18n to render.

ConfirmResetPermissionsModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: history icon, 'reset permissions to defaults?' text, cancel + primary yes buttons.
ConfirmResetPermissionsModal.note: Fully static markup, no dynamic state in body; only needs i18n init and forced-visible modal classes.

ConfirmRestartPanoModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: refresh icon, warning alert + 'restart in background' switch (when runMode not background), password input, cancel + warning yes buttons with spinner.
ConfirmRestartPanoModal.note: Renders from runMode prop ({background:boolean}); imports $lib/api.util and getContext('platformRestarting') but both only used on submit; shim i18n + bootstrap.

ConfirmSaveCriticalSettingsModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: warning-triangle icon, critical-settings warning text, password input, cancel + warning save buttons with spinner.
ConfirmSaveCriticalSettingsModal.note: Body is static form; callback passed via module show(); only i18n + forced-visible shim needed.

ConfirmSendVerificationEmailModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: question icon, 'send verification email?' description, cancel + primary yes buttons with spinner.
ConfirmSendVerificationEmailModal.note: Static body; imports $lib/api.util and ToastContainer's show (submit-only); shim i18n + bootstrap, force visible.

ConfirmStopPanoModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: stop-circle icon, 'stop Pano?' text, password input, cancel + red yes buttons with spinner.
ConfirmStopPanoModal.note: Static body; $lib/api.util used only on submit; needs i18n + bootstrap shim and forced-visible classes.

ConfirmStopThemeModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: question icon, 'stop theme?' text, password input, cancel + red yes buttons with spinner.
ConfirmStopThemeModal.note: Purely static body driven by module stores with sane defaults; i18n + forced-visible shim suffice.

ConfirmUpdatePlatformModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: download icon, 'update platform?' text, optional terminal-mode warning alert + background switch, cancel + secondary yes buttons.
ConfirmUpdatePlatformModal.note: Renders from runMode prop alone; no API imports; i18n + forced-visible shim only.

ConfirmUpdateResourceModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: download icon, 'update this resource?' text, cancel + secondary yes buttons.
ConfirmUpdateResourceModal.note: Fully static body; i18n + forced-visible modal classes only.

ConfirmUpdateResourcesModal.role: Centered confirm dialog: download icon, 'update all resources?' text, cancel + secondary yes buttons; near-identical twin of ConfirmUpdateResourceModal.
ConfirmUpdateResourcesModal.note: Fully static body; i18n + forced-visible modal classes only.

ConnectServerModal.role: Larger modal with header toggle-switch + title, numbered 3-step setup list, local/remote tabs, readonly '/pano connect ...' command input with copy/console-copy buttons and refresh countdown.
ConnectServerModal.note: Crashes at init without svelte contexts (session.basicData, platformServerMatchKey, platformKeyRefreshedTime, platformHostAddress); context subscriptions trigger API key-refresh; needs $lib/api.util, $lib/variables, tooltip action, browser shim.

CreatePermissionGroupModal.role: Form modal: header with close, floating inputs for display name / group name / weight, parent-groups list with remove buttons, add-parent select, create/save footer button.
CreatePermissionGroupModal.note: All form state lives in module-level stores populated by show(payload); renders empty-but-valid statically; imports local NoContent component; i18n + forced-visible shim.

Date.role: Inline span showing a formatted or relative date with a full-timestamp tooltip on hover
Date.note: Needs currentLanguage store default (dateFnsCode) and tooltip.util/tippy present; then renders from `time` prop alone; note it mutates String.prototype

DefaultToast.role: Standard toast notification body rendering a localized HTML message inside the Toast shell
DefaultToast.note: Needs svelte-i18n initialized and whatever Toast.svelte requires (likely bootstrap toast JS / dismissal store)

DragAndDropZone.role: Dashed-border file drop zone with icon/title/subtitle, drag-over highlight, hidden file input; dispatches drop/error events
DragAndDropZone.note: Fully self-contained; renders from props alone (legacy createEventDispatcher events won't wire into React but visuals are fine)

Editor.role: TipTap rich-text editor with heading/format/list/media toolbar and optional HTML-source and preview modes
Editor.note: No SvelteKit/API deps, but instantiates a TipTap Editor at init and mounts it in onMount — needs the tiptap bundle and a real DOM; i18n for toolbar labels
Editor.children: children snippet appended inside the input-group

EditPermissionNodeModal.role: Rich form modal: node input with autocomplete suggestion dropdown (icons, badges, ticks), pano/game-only alert banners, active switch, never/date expiry radio group, key/value context rows, add/save footer.
EditPermissionNodeModal.note: State via module show(payload) which also lazy-fetches /api/panel/permission/registered; without show() renders 'no node selected' placeholder; needs realistic payload + i18n (also reads dictionary/locale stores) + $lib/variables and NoContent; forced-visible shim.

EditPermTrackModal.role: Bootstrap modal with name/description inputs plus drag-and-drop pill buttons and an ordered list-group to compose a permission-track's group sequence
EditPermTrackModal.note: No props; state lives in module writables set by exported show(payload) which needs window.bootstrap.Modal shim; renders fine with i18n + a show() call passing permissionGroups/track

EditPlayerModal.role: Large edit-player form modal: username/email inputs, merged password grid, clear-password switch, locale select, ticket/email-verified switches, plugin card rows
EditPlayerModal.note: Depends on $page.data.user, getContext('user'/'siteInfo') stores, PluginAPI executeLifecycle and plugin ViewComponent resolution inside show(); heavy runtime context to render correctly

EditRegisterAgreementModal.role: Modal with a require-agreement checkbox and a TipTap rich-text Editor for the register agreement HTML
EditRegisterAgreementModal.note: Needs show(html, cb) + bootstrap shim; embedded TipTap Editor is client-only and adds weight but renders without backend

FailedLoginPanoStoreAlert.role: Static danger alert with warning icon for failed Pano Store login
FailedLoginPanoStoreAlert.note: Only needs svelte-i18n initialized with the panel locale JSON

Hook.role: Invisible plugin extension point: mounts registered plugin UI components into a container element
Hook.note: Depends on the runtime plugin registry (panoApiClient.ui.hook), $page.data, permission checks, and manual mount/unmount; renders nothing without live plugins

InstallingResourceModal.role: Install-progress modal: striped/animated progress bar, step/error text, success footer with go-to-store and back buttons
InstallingResourceModal.note: show() immediately uploads/opens SSE streams; uses beforeNavigate and goto from SvelteKit runtime; progress state only comes from live install flow

InstallResourceModal.role: Two-pane choice modal: drag-and-drop upload zone (.jar/.zip) beside a 'install from Pano store' link tile
InstallResourceModal.note: Presentational once shown; needs show(type) + bootstrap shim and base-path stub; no data fetch

IpBanRow.role: Table row: actions dropdown (unban), IP in code tag, remaining ban duration with tooltip, reason, source badge, banned-by, date
IpBanRow.note: Needs auth-permission shim (dropdown hidden otherwise), store/i18n shims, Bootstrap JS for dropdown open state

JumpToPageModal.role: Small centered modal with a number input and cancel/go footer for pagination jump
JumpToPageModal.note: Fully self-contained; only needs i18n and a bootstrap Modal shim plus show(current, max, cb)

LicenseStatusBadge.role: Green/red key icon with tooltip (optional small text label) indicating DRM license status
LicenseStatusBadge.note: Pure prop-driven; needs i18n keys, tooltip.util (tippy) and a websiteDisplayHost stub

LocaleRow.role: Table row: delete button, locale name (edit link), locale code, dateFns code, derivatives, defined-by label
LocaleRow.note: Pure presentational; only needs i18n initialized and a locale object prop

MakeMainServerModal.role: Yes/no confirmation modal with question-circle icon asking to make a server the main server
MakeMainServerModal.note: Renders from show(server) alone; API call only on confirm click, so static render just needs i18n + bootstrap shim

MarkdownRenderer.role:
Renders sanitized markdown as inline HTML with the leading

unwrapped and links opening in new tabs
MarkdownRenderer.note: Renders from `content` prop; needs marked + sanitizer bundled and a browser=true shim for $app/environment

Navbar.role: Top navbar: sidebar toggler, website/server switcher, page title, notifications dropdown, theme picker, account dropdown with avatar
Navbar.note: Requires 9 Svelte contexts, $lib/Store stores, Bootstrap JS dropdown events wired in onMount (getElementById), avatar API endpoints, and notification API calls

stores: 9 getContext stores (selectedServer, pageTitle, user, notificationCount, isSidebarOpen, session, panelTheme, sidebarTabsState, siteInfo)

NoContent.role: Faded empty-state card with a large icon and a message
NoContent.note: Pure presentational; default text calls the i18n store at init so svelte-i18n must be initialized before mount

NotificationContainer.role: Fixed bottom-right stack of Bootstrap toast cards showing quick notifications with avatar/icon, relative time, and markdown-rendered i18n text
NotificationContainer.note: Polls /api/panel/notifications/quick on mount, needs getContext('notificationCount'), window.bootstrap.Toast, and realtime hook; renders empty without live data

PageActions.role: Responsive three-zone toolbar row (left/center/right) with horizontal-scroll centering for page action bars
PageActions.note: Pure layout from slots and class props; note slot render is gated on the corresponding *Classes prop being non-null
PageActions.children: legacy named slots: left, middle, right

PageLoader.role: Fixed top-of-viewport blue tweened progress bar shown during SvelteKit navigation
PageLoader.note: Needs a $app/stores navigating shim (a readable(null) makes it complete/fade; readable(true) shows it mid-progress); otherwise self-contained

PageLoading.role: Centered Bootstrap spinner-border filling the page area, toggled by the show prop

PageNav.role: Horizontally scrollable centered Bootstrap nav-pills container for page tabs
PageNav.note: Pure wrapper; just needs PageNavItem (or any) children in the slot

PageNavItem.role: Single Bootstrap nav-pill item (link or button) with active/disabled states inside a PageNav
PageNavItem.note: Pass active explicitly to bypass $page matching; still needs $page/$base stubs since they are read at init

Pagination.role: Bootstrap small pagination bar with prev/next carets, windowed page numbers, and '...' jump-to-page trigger
Pagination.note: Renders from props + i18n; imports JumpToPageModal (renders hidden, only needs Bootstrap JS if '...' is clicked); events via createEventDispatcher

PermissionEditor.role: Editable table of permission nodes (text input, true/false select, expiry select+datetime, context badge) with add-node/add-group header buttons
PermissionEditor.note: Renders from permissions array prop + i18n; references undefined openAddPermissionModal in header (pass showHeader=false or provide realistic props); NoContent shown when empty

PermissionGroupRow.role: Table row: delete button (hidden for admin), group name link, permission count (infinity icon for admin), user count
PermissionGroupRow.note: Only needs i18n and a $app/paths base shim

PlayerPermissionBadge.role: Rounded-pill secondary badge linking to players filtered by permission group, showing capitalized group display name.
PlayerPermissionBadge.note: Needs i18n locale JSON and $app/paths shim; note it monkey-patches String.prototype.capitalize.

PlayerRow.role: Table row: actions dropdown (authorize/edit/ban), avatar+username link, permission badge, status badge, last-login and register dates, plugin Hook slots
PlayerRow.note: Crashes without getContext('user') store; Hook needs plugin API client and $app/stores $page stub

PlayerStatusBadge.role: Rounded-pill status badge: red 'Banned', green 'Online' (gamepad/globe icon for in-game vs website), or blue 'Offline' with relative last-seen tooltip.
PlayerStatusBadge.note: Pure props + i18n; online state derives from lastActivityTime vs Date.now(), so pass a recent timestamp to show online.

PostCategoryRow.role: Table row: delete button, category title (edit), description, public category URL link, hidden color swatch input, plugin Hook slots
PostCategoryRow.note: Needs UI_URL variable and Hook shim (panoApiClient + $page stub); otherwise prop-driven

PostRow.role: Table row: actions dropdown (view/draft/publish/trash), 16:9 thumbnail, title link, category badge, views, writer avatar, date, plugin Hook slots
PostRow.note: Imports PageTypes from the Posts page module (pulls page graph) and Hook/panoApiClient; needs UI_URL, base, avatarVersion shims and realistic post object (post.writer.username required)

RemoveServerModal.role: Confirm-delete modal with icon, account-password input, and cancel/yes (danger) footer
RemoveServerModal.note: Static content once shown; API/goto only fire on confirm; needs i18n + bootstrap shim + show(server)

RestartingModal.role: Non-dismissable overlay modal with spinning rotate icon, title and description shown while the platform restarts
RestartingModal.note: Pure presentational but gated on a getContext('platformRestarting') store — needs a context shim set to writable(true); no bootstrap JS needed (always-rendered .show markup)

SearchInput.role: Small debounced Bootstrap input-group search box with optional inline searching spinner
SearchInput.note: Only needs svelte-i18n initialized for placeholder/aria keys; otherwise self-contained

SearchPlayerModal.role: Player search modal: large search input with clear button, status hint, avatar+group result list with Add/Select badges
SearchPlayerModal.note: Empty/start-typing state renders from show() alone; result list requires seeding module stores or a mocked search API; avatar imgs hit /api/profile/picture

ServerActivityMiniChart.role: 60px absolutely-positioned white translucent sparkline (area line chart) pinned to the bottom of a parent card, tooltip on hover.
ServerActivityMiniChart.note: Renders from one prop, but is position:absolute (needs a relative colored parent card to look right); tooltip label references $_ without importing it — hovering would throw. i18n init still needed.

ServerNavigationMenu.role: Vertical dark sidebar nav for the selected Minecraft server (dashboard/statistics/settings) with active-route highlighting, or a NoContent placeholder when no server is selected/connected.
ServerNavigationMenu.note: Depends on getContext('selectedServer'/'connectedServerCount') stores, the PluginAPI serverNavigationItems store, and a $page stub; without all of these it renders the empty-state only or crashes.
ServerNavigationMenu.children: none (renders NoContent child component in empty states)

ServerPlayerChart.role: 120px pie chart of online vs remaining player slots, theme-aware colors (reads --bs-border-color and data-bs-theme), no legend.
ServerPlayerChart.note: Two numeric props; needs i18n JSON for tooltip labels and Bootstrap CSS vars for border color; chart drawn in onMount, no network.

ServerRequestModal.role: Server connect-request modal: server card (favicon, type badge, player count, address), display-name input, reject/connect footer
ServerRequestModal.note: show(serverId) fetches server data immediately and starts in a spinner state; without live API it stays on the loading spinner; also needs selectedServer context

ServersModal.role: XL modal listing pinned/other server cards in a responsive grid with search, placeholder-glow skeletons while loading, and a connect-server button
ServersModal.note: show() fetches /api/panel/servers and subscribes to panelRealtime websocket events in onMount; without backend it stays in skeleton state; needs selectedServer context

ServersModalServerCard.role: Clickable server card: favicon, name, copyable address code, ONLINE/OFFLINE badge, player count, crown for main server, selecting spinner overlay, selected footer
ServersModalServerCard.note: Prop-driven and highly showable, but reads selectedServer/mainServer via getContext (store shims needed), uses tippy tooltip action and $app/paths base

Sidebar.role: Primary-colored collapsible offcanvas sidebar: logo header, website/server tab pills, scrollable navigation menu, fixed bottom section
Sidebar.note: Requires getContext for sidebarTabsState/isSidebarOpen/siteInfo, window.bootstrap.Offcanvas, auth permission state, and child menus that read session data

SiteNavigationMenu.role: Main dark sidebar nav (dashboard, posts, tickets, players, settings, etc.) with permission-filtered items, active-route highlight, and an update-available dot on Settings.
SiteNavigationMenu.note: Requires getContext('session') store with basicData.hasUpdate, hasPermission() backed by session state, PluginAPI store, and a $page stub; renders empty/crashes without them.

Splash.role: Full-viewport animated loading splash cycling Pano/Minecraft/Hytale logos, with error text + retry buttons and a delayed 'stuck?' refresh prompt
Splash.note: Needs getContext('session') stub with basicData, base path shim, and $lib/Store; happy path renders fine with an empty networkErrorCallbacks store

SummaryStatCard.role: KPI card: title, big formatted value, optional secondary value, up/down/neutral trend pill with tooltip, and a filled sparkline along the bottom.
SummaryStatCard.note: Fully prop-driven; needs i18n JSON (trend tooltip strings), Bootstrap card CSS, and tooltip action shim.

TableThumbnail.role: 40px-tall 16:9 rounded thumbnail linked to href, or an icon placeholder tile when src is absent
TableThumbnail.note: Pure presentational; i18n only for the default tooltip text; use an http(s) or data src to avoid the -preview URL rewrite

ThemeColorMenu.role: Row of round color-dot buttons (light/dark/copper) for picking the panel color theme, active dot ringed
ThemeColorMenu.note: Pure presentational; just needs i18n for tooltips/aria labels

ThemeLicenseCard.role: Bootstrap card showing premium-theme license status with badge, status copy per state, refresh button, and buy/connect CTAs
ThemeLicenseCard.note: Renders statically from a theme prop with premium:true and a licenseStatus; API/invalidateAll only fire on refresh click (needs $app/navigation + $app/paths shims)

TicketCategoryRow.role: Table row: delete button, category title as edit button, truncated description
TicketCategoryRow.note: Pure presentational; only i18n and a category object

TicketRow.role: Table row: select checkbox, #id, title link, category badge, writer avatar+name, status badge, last-update date
TicketRow.note: checkedList must be passed as a writable store; needs base/avatarVersion/tooltip shims and ticket.writer.username

stores: checkedList prop is itself a svelte store

TicketStatusBadge.role: Rounded-pill link badge colored by ticket status: green New, yellow Replied, red Closed; links to filtered ticket list.
TicketStatusBadge.note: Pure presentational; i18n + $app/paths shim. Module also exports TicketStatuses enum.

Toast.role: Single Bootstrap toast shell (tertiary background, shadow) whose body is the slot content
Toast.note: Pure markup; add the Bootstrap 'show' class manually (base .toast is display:none until shown)

thirdParty: bootstrap toast CSS (visibility needs .show or Bootstrap JS)

ToastContainer.role: Fixed bottom-center stack that renders queued toast components pushed via the exported show() module function
ToastContainer.note: Renders empty unless the module show() API is called; showing requires window.bootstrap.Toast at runtime
ToastContainer.children: none (renders dynamic toast components via svelte:component)

TranslationRow.role: Three floating-label form fields per row (readonly key, readonly original, editable custom translation) plus optional delete button
TranslationRow.note: Pure form-row presentational; needs only i18n and a translation object

TranslationSkeleton.role: Three animated shimmering skeleton placeholder blocks mimicking a TranslationRow while loading; theme-aware via data-bs-theme
TranslationSkeleton.note: Zero props, zero imports; only needs Bootstrap CSS variables present

UnbanIpModal.role: Confirmation modal (question icon, cancel/yes-danger footer) for removing an IP ban
UnbanIpModal.note: Renders from show(bannedIp) alone; API only on confirm; needs i18n + bootstrap shim

UnbanPlayerModal.role: Confirmation modal (question icon, cancel/yes-danger footer) for unbanning a player
UnbanPlayerModal.note: Renders from show(player) alone; API only on confirm; needs i18n + bootstrap shim

UnnecessaryTranslationsAlert.role: Warning alert with a collapsible details list of obsolete translation rows (hardcoded English summary text)
UnnecessaryTranslationsAlert.note: Needs realistic translations array; depends on TranslationRow child (check its own coupling); events bubble via dispatcher

VerifiedStatus.role: Small green check or yellow exclamation icon with tooltip indicating verified/not-verified state
VerifiedStatus.note: Renders from one string prop; needs i18n and the tippy tooltip action (harmless if tooltip is shimmed)

ViewActivityLogModal.role: Read-only modal showing an activity log's details as pretty-printed JSON in a 10-row textarea
ViewActivityLogModal.note: Fully self-contained; show(activityLog) + i18n + bootstrap shim is enough

ViewAllLink.role: Small 'view all' arrow link (or custom slot content) styled as a Bootstrap btn-link
ViewAllLink.note: Pure presentational; only needs i18n for the aria-label/title

ViewComponent.role: Invisible dynamic-component mount point used for plugin view slots; renders whatever component it is given
ViewComponent.note: Renders nothing without a real compiled Svelte component prop (typically supplied by the plugin-UI loader); not meaningful as a standalone visual

WebsiteActivityChart.role: 300px-tall multi-series line chart (registrations, visitors, views) over a week/month time axis with legend, tooltips, and dark-mode-aware colors.
WebsiteActivityChart.note: Renders from props with fake time-series data, but pulls DashboardPeriod from a page module and currentLanguage store; canvas render happens in onMount (client-only), no network.

WhatsNewModal.role: Marketing what's-new modal: branded hero header with Pano logo and decorative blocks, 2x2 feature grid with gradient icons, optional don't-show-again switch footer
WhatsNewModal.note: Content is fully static i18n text; needs base-path stub for logo image (hardcoded /panel/assets svgs) and bootstrap shim to show; API only fires on dismissal
